enchantments.tooltip: Fortification +100%: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
Constitution +5: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +5 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
